label: Hashnode
terms_note: PAID since 2026-05-13: all GraphQL requests (queries + mutations) require a Pro plan on the publication (seat-based pricing, self-serve upgrade in Billing; allow-listing is automatic after checkout); the change was made because scrapers / spammers abused the free API; personal access token in the Authorization header; rate limits not restated on the pages read.

auth: 1. Publication owner upgrades to **Pro** (Billing › Upgrade to Pro; seat-based price) — allow-listing is automatic
2. Personal Access Token from the account's Developer settings → header `Authorization: <token>` (BYO per tenant).
reference.limits: - Pro subscription per publication; API abused by scrapers / spammers was the stated reason for the paywall; rate limits not restated on the pages read (earlier docs: per-token throttling). - Hashnode terms: no spam publications; links nofollow unless the publication is on a custom domain the tenant owns.

reason: Hashnode runs an official remote MCP server, https://mcp.hashnode.com/mcp ('MCP connect links any MCP client directly to your Hashnode publications ... it can create, read, update, list, and delete posts'; https://hashnode.com/changelog/2026-09-22-mcp-connect), and since 2026-05-13 every GraphQL API request 'now requires a Pro plan on your publication' (https://hashnode.com/changelog/2026-05-13-graphql-api-paid-access); use the official server rather than a duplicate adapter.
